Print Type CategoriesNo / Partial Foil and Full Foil
⌄
Yu-Gi-Oh! has an unusually complex rarity system. Cards are grouped into two Roca print-type buckets based on how much of the card uses foil or a foil coating.
Choose a rarity inside each print-type bucket to see a card example and the visual features that make the rarity unique.
ROCA PRINT TYPE

No / Partial Foil

No foil, or foil covers only part of the card.
